semantics: WOO and OPO are killed mutants (oracle-detected and not oracle-detected respectively); Survivor is not killed. This project’s binary target is killed-vs-survived, not oracle-detected-vs-undetected.

source_gate_count_match.decision: Not part of the registered feature list and excluded from comparison models. It varies by label; treat as suspicious until a same-fold with/without ablation and provenance review are complete. Association alone does not establish target leakage.
